dependencies.name: moltenvk
dependencies.form: existing source snapshot; NOT a qualified artifact
platforms: macOS/iOS upstream only; not enabled by FOO normal builds
flags: Xcode/Metal SDK; upstream ExternalRevisions dependencies not bundled
dependencies.use: not in normal build; future runtime ICD; no macOS support claim

dependencies.name: qbe
dependencies.form: QBE 1.3 source with target-specific local changes, built by tools/qbe/build.mjs
platforms: Windows x64 native backend; Linux x64 and ARM64 native backends and cross-target assembly
flags: Target ABI selected by the QBE driver

dependencies.name: tinycc
dependencies.form: 0.9.28rc source with local Windows x64 vectorcall, QBE scalar-SSE assembler, x64 inline memcpy, and explicit DLL export changes, plus 0.9.27 Windows x64 bootstrap binaries
platforms: Windows x64 native QBE linker and C frontend
Linux x64 and ARM64 TinyCC C frontend and linker
dependencies.use: build-time compiler; tools/tcc/build.mjs and tools/tcc/linux/build.mjs build from this source

dependencies.name: binutils-assemblers-and-linkers
dependencies.form: Ubuntu 22.04 x64 assembler and linker executables plus a static ARM64-host assembler built from pinned Ubuntu source
platforms: linux-x64 host: x64, ARM64 and RISC-V ELF assembly and freestanding linking
linux-arm64 host: native ARM64 ELF assembly
flags: LD_LIBRARY_PATH points to bundled x64 libraries
ARM64 as: aarch64-linux-musl static, stripped; tools/binutils/linux/build.mjs
dependencies.use: QBE native assembly and freestanding ELF linking
